services.name: Original Sunset Cocktail Cruise
services.desc: Kick off a big night on the town with a Maui sunset cruise! Duration Approx. 2 Hours About Sea Maui’s ’Original Sunset Cocktail Cruise’ is a Ka'anapali tradition. Sunsets at sea, viewed from Sea Maui are spectacular and during our winter months our sunset trips are also a whale watching tour! Our guest will take in a panoramic view of Molokai, Lanai, Maui and Kahoolawe while enjoying Appetizers and a premium open bar including local beers, white wine, champagne, light rum, dark rum, vodka, whisky and mixers. Each night is different and special aboard Sea Maui. What better way to end your day? Departure information This cruise departs directly from Ka'anapali beach. Check in times vary

services.name: Premium Sunset with Dinner
services.desc: A Unique Dining Experience! - - Live music on Wednesdays and Saturdays starting November 29th! Duration 2.5 Hours About Sea Maui’s Premium Sunset with Dinner is our premium ocean dining experience. Leave behind the hustle and bustle of the land when you're welcomed onboard our newest vessel the beautiful Sea Maui III, a 65ft newly refurbished luxury catamaran. Feel the mana of the ocean beneath you as you cruise along the shoreline and enjoy the humbling panoramic views of Maui and its surrounding islands during the magic hours of sunset. services.name: 2 Hour Whale Watch
services.desc: Join us onboard our spacious catamaran as we search for these magnificent creatures and experience them in their winter playground. Duration 2 Hours About During Sea Maui's winter months (Dec 15th-April 15th) Humpback whales migrate down from the cold waters of Alaska to the warm waters of Maui to give birth to their calves and train them in the safe, calm waters off Ka'anapali. Chat with our naturalists if you are interest in learning about the whales or if prefer just grab a bean bag, a cocktail and enjoy nature's show! This sail includes a full open bar. services.name: Xpress Snorkel
services.desc: Open Bar Included! Duration 2.5 Hours | 8am-10:30am Description This snorkel adventure is unique to Sea Maui and offers the fastest option to get you from the beach and straight to the snorkeling in no time. Once on board the captain and crew will take you to one of West Maui’s premier snorkeling spots just a quick ride from Ka’anapali by boat. Here you’ll likely be up close and personal with the resident Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles, colorful tropical fish, beautiful coral reef and many other surprises depending on the day. services.name: Afternoon West Maui Snorkel
services.desc: Not exactly a morning person? This is the snorkel trip for you! Duration 3.5 hours About With an afternoon departure time, and duration of 3 hours you can take the morning to relax then hop on the boat and do some of Maui’s best snorkeling. Once on board the captain and crew will take you to one of West Maui's most popular snorkeling locations (depending on conditions). Here you’ll likely be up close and personal with the resident Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles, colorful tropical fish, beautiful coral reef and many other surprises depending on the day. services.name: West Maui Half Day Snorkel Adventure
services.desc: WEST MAUI SNORKEL Duration 4.5 hours About Your West Maui Half Day Snorkel Adventure departs directly from the beautiful sands of Kaanapali Beach behind Whaler’s Village. As we set off in search of West Maui’s best snorkel sites you will be offered a hot breakfast prepared by Cafe Jai. Along the way keep your eyes open for Hawaiian spinner dolphins, bottle nose dolphins and during the winter months you can experience the humpback whales that migrate from Alaska to our Maui waters. The Captain will determine the best sites to visit that day based upon current water conditions. Some popular sites include Honolua Bay, Cliff House, Oluwalu, Mala Wharf and more.
